title: Maximum Points in an Archery Competition
goal: Allocate Bob arrows to maximize the points won against Alice.
strategy: Winning a section requires exactly one more arrow than Alice used there. Enumerate subsets of won sections, keep the best affordable score, and place unused arrows in the zero-point section.
